meat-46.title: Baked Pan-Seared Chicken
meat-46.culturalNotes: Baked casserole dishes (sanyia) are weeknight staples in Egyptian homes, combining meat, vegetables, and sauce in one dish.

instructions.1: Mix the flour well with the cumin, coriander, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Quarter the chicken and coat it in the mixture.
instructions.3: Brown in oil until golden, then drain on paper towels.
instructions.4: Oil a tray, arrange the chicken in it, cover, and bake.

mp47-5.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, and cinnamon

instructions.1: Sear the leg in a tray with oil or ghee along with sliced onions that have been rubbed with salt, pepper, mixed spices, and cinnamon.
instructions.2: Pierce whole garlic cloves into the leg, or simply place them around it without piercing.
instructions.3: Add the onion juice and vinegar to the leg.
instructions.4: Wrap the tray tightly in foil and pour a little water around the meat.
instructions.5: Place in the oven, adding more water as needed until fully cooked.

instructions.1: Blend the onion, salt, pepper, garlic, tomatoes, and spices in a blender, then add the yogurt, or use any of your preferred oven roasting marinades.
instructions.2: Make a deep opening next to the bone and pour half of the mixture into it.
instructions.3: Flip the leg to the other side, apply the rest of the marinade, and then add the oil.
instructions.4: Wrap in foil, place in a baking dish, and put in the oven until cooked through.
instructions.5: Once the leg is cooked, pour the remaining sauce into a small pot. Mix the cornstarch or flour with a little water (proportional to the amount of sauce) and pour it into the sauce over low heat, stirring until it thickens.
instructions.6: Open the foil and pour the thickened sauce over the leg.
instructions.7: Serve with sautéed vegetables on the side.

meat-49.title: Meat or Chicken in Yogurt Sauce

mp49-8.name: Salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme

instructions.1: Blend the tomato, onion, pepper, garlic, lemon juice or vinegar, mustard, spices, and yogurt in a blender, or use any oven-roasting marinade.
instructions.2: Place the meat or chicken in a greased baking dish, pour the mixture over it, cover, and refrigerate for 4 hours.
instructions.3: Place the dish in the oven at medium heat, adding a little water if necessary, until cooked through.
instructions.4: Remove the cover and leave it in the oven until the liquid is completely absorbed.

meat-50.title: Rolled Roasted Meat
meat-50.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Slice the onion into rings and mash it with salt, pepper and mixed spice.
instructions.2: Cut the meat into small, even pieces and drizzle with the oil.
instructions.3: Mix the meat with the mashed onion and oil, wrap in foil, and seal well.
instructions.4: Bake for about 2 hours, until fully cooked.

mp51-1.name: minced meat or leftover boiled chicken

mp51-6.name: salt, pepper, thyme, mixed spices, and turmeric

instructions.1: Prepare a food processor to mince the meat or leftover chicken with the grated carrot, green pepper, and spices.
instructions.2: Add one beaten egg and half a cup of milk to the mixture and mix well.
instructions.3: Prepare a mold, grease it with oil, and press the mixture into it.
instructions.4: Place in the oven at medium heat, and once cooked, cut into slices.

mp52-8.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, thyme, cinnamon, and cloves

instructions.1: Grease a baking dish with oil, cut the boiled chicken into quarters, and place it in the dish.
instructions.2: Slice the onion and sauté in oil in a pan until golden.
instructions.3: Slice the pepper and add it to the onions along with the minced garlic; sauté well, then add the vinegar and spices.
instructions.4: Add one cup of broth or water to the mixture; once boiling, pour it over the chicken and place in a medium oven until the liquid is absorbed and the top is browned.

instructions.1: Prepare a baking dish or Pyrex and spread a layer of cornflakes at the bottom to serve as a base.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken into small pieces, and slice the olives and green pepper.
instructions.3: Place the chicken, olives, and pepper on top of the cornflakes.
instructions.4: Make a thick béchamel sauce by heating the oil and adding the flour; once it turns golden, add the cup of milk along with salt and pepper while off the heat and stir, then return to medium heat until the consistency thickens.
instructions.5: Pour the béchamel over the chicken and sprinkle shredded Rumi cheese on top.
instructions.6: Sprinkle a small amount of cornflakes over the shredded cheese, cover, and place in the oven.

meat-54.title: Mustard-Glazed Chicken
meat-54.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Slice the chicken breasts thinly and brown in hot oil until golden, then remove and arrange in a tray.
instructions.2: In the same pot, add more oil or ghee, whisk in the mustard quickly over low heat, then whisk in the clotted cream dissolved in milk, and add water as needed.
instructions.3: Once it boils, pour the sauce over the chicken in the tray, cover, and bake until fully cooked.

instructions.1: Slice the chicken breasts and sauté them in oil until golden, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Season the grated onion with salt, pepper, spices, and vinegar, then spread it over the chicken in a baking dish.
instructions.3: Sprinkle any type of shredded cheese over the chicken and mix well with the meat.
instructions.4: Pour the cup of cream over the top and bake in the oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

mp56-3.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme

instructions.1: Rub the sliced onions with salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme.
instructions.2: Add the tablespoon of ghee and the breadcrumbs, mixing well, then knead with milk until the mixture becomes soft.
instructions.3: Stuff the duck with this mixture and place it in a baking tray greased with oil or ghee; drizzle some ghee or oil over the top and cover with foil.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until cooked through, then remove the foil to allow the skin to brown.

instructions.1: Finely mince the onion with the garlic and bay leaves, then season with the spices and add plenty of lemon juice.
instructions.2: Season the turkey thoroughly inside and out, then refrigerate for one full day.
instructions.3: Prepare a baking tray greased with oil, place the marinated turkey inside, and cover it with foil.
instructions.4: Place in the oven for approximately 2 hours, making sure to flip it onto the other side halfway through.
instructions.5: Once cooked, slice the turkey and arrange the pieces on a serving platter.

instructions.1: Mix the meat with the minced onion, lemon juice, and spices, then leave it in the refrigerator for 12 hours.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture with the egg and breadcrumbs until the desired consistency is reached.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into medium-sized fingers, piercing them with a skewer to create a hole.
instructions.4: Grease the tray with ghee and arrange the kofta fingers inside, then add 2 tablespoons of ghee on top; cover and bake in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.5: Once cooked, char a piece of charcoal thoroughly on the stove, place it in the middle of the tray on a little ghee, cover immediately, and shake the tray until the charcoal aroma spreads throughout.

instructions.1: Rub the chopped onion with the vinegar, garlic, yogurt, and mustard.
instructions.2: Cut the boiled chicken into small pieces and mix thoroughly with the mixture.
instructions.3: Sauté in a pan without oil over low heat until the onion liquid is absorbed, then increase the heat.
instructions.4: Prepare a tray greased with oil and place the chicken in it; then slice the pepper and tomato and place them on top of the chicken with the lemon juice, vinegar, and parsley to prevent the chicken from drying out.
instructions.5: To brown the top, you can place the tray under the broiler for a very short time.

instructions.1: Season the ground chicken well with salt, pepper, chopped bell pepper, cheese, and tahini.
instructions.2: Prepare a sheet of phyllo pastry brushed with butter, place a portion of the chicken mixture inside, and roll it into triangles, brushing the outside with butter.
instructions.3: Place in a lightly greased baking dish and repeat with the remaining phyllo sheets.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee or oil, add the flour, and stir well until it turns slightly golden, then remove the pan from the heat.
instructions.2: Gradually add the milk or broth while off the heat, stirring constantly until smooth, then return the pan to the stove over medium heat until it reaches the desired thickness, ensuring the sauce remains slightly fluid.
instructions.3: Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Variation with parsley or lemon: Optionally, add 1 tsp of chopped parsley or 1 tsp of lemon juice to the sauce while it is still hot.
instructions.5: Variation with mustard and vinegar (Method 1): Alternatively, mix 1 tsp of mustard well with 1 tbsp of vinegar, add it to the sauce, and bring it back to a boil on the stove.
instructions.6: Variation with mustard and vinegar (Method 2): Or, add 1 tsp of mustard directly to the sauce and stir well, then let it cool; subsequently, gradually whisk in 1 tbsp of oil alternating with 1 tbsp of vinegar, stirring constantly until emulsified.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish and lightly fry it in oil (half-fry only), then remove it from the oil and set aside.
instructions.2: Sauté the sliced onions in the same oil until they turn golden, then add the minced garlic and dried coriander and stir.
instructions.3: Add the blended tomatoes and leave over low heat, seasoning with salt as needed, and adding a little water if necessary until the tomatoes cook down and thicken into a sauce.
instructions.4: Place the lightly fried fish into the sauce, cover the pot, and leave over low heat until cooked through.
instructions.5: Oven method (alternative): You can replace the pot with a baking dish, place the same ingredients inside, cover, and bake in the oven until cooked instead of cooking on the stovetop.
instructions.6: Serving: Serve with tahini salad or a white seafood sauce.

instructions.1: Clean and butterfly the fish: Clean the fish and butterfly it by making a wide longitudinal cut along the belly (without separating the two halves), then season both the inside and outside with the chopped onion, minced garlic, spices, and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Prepare the filling: Slice the tomatoes and green peppers into thin rings.
instructions.3: Stuff and marinate: Place the tomato and green pepper rings inside the opened belly of the fish and let the stuffed fish sit for a while to absorb the marinade.
instructions.4: Baking: Grease a baking tray and arrange the fish in it, drizzle a little oil and lemon juice over the top, then place in the oven until fully cooked and golden brown.
instructions.5: Serving: Serve with tahini salad or a white seafood sauce.

instructions.1: Sauté the onion in oil, then add the garlic and chopped tomatoes; add about 1 cup of water with the sugar and let it boil for approximately 5 minutes over medium heat.
instructions.2: Grease a baking dish with oil and pour in the sautéed onion along with its liquid.
instructions.3: Cut the potatoes into medium cubes and add them to the sauce in the baking dish along with 2 tablespoons of tomato paste.
instructions.4: Prepare a light white sauce: In the same first pot, melt the butter and stir in the flour well, then add the spices, celery, and parsley with enough water to reach a medium consistency (it is preferable to keep it thin if the potatoes are being cooked with the fish).
instructions.5: Place the fish pieces into this white sauce, then pour the mixture over the sauce and potatoes in the baking dish.
instructions.6: Cover the dish and place it in the oven until cooked through, reserving a little sauce to pour over the fish when serving.
instructions.7: Serving: Serve with tahini salad or a white seafood sauce.

instructions.1: Cleaning: Clean the squid with hot water and wash very thoroughly, then toss with vinegar and place in a strainer for one minute.
instructions.2: If the squid is large, bring water to a boil, drop the squid in for just one single boil, then drain.
instructions.3: Cut the squid into rings or long strips, trimming off the ends.
instructions.4: Seasoning: Place in a deep bowl and season with vinegar, salt, pepper, cumin, and the juice of the two lemons; let marinate for at least one hour.
instructions.5: Place in a strainer to dry completely from excess water and marinade, then dredge the rings in flour.
instructions.6: Fry the rings in plenty of oil until golden.
instructions.7: Serving: Serve with tahini salad or white seafood sauce.

sf10-4.name: cumin, black pepper, mastic, and cardamom

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp several times to ensure all sand is completely removed.
instructions.2: Slice the onions into rings and layer them in the pot, alternating with the shrimp, celery, spices, a little salt, and lemon juice.
instructions.3: You may add a little water if the shrimp are large in size.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and place it over low heat, stirring constantly until cooked through.
instructions.5: Remove the pot from the heat and shake it well so the shrimp do not stick together.
instructions.6: Serve as desired, either in the shell or peeled, with tahini salad or a white seafood sauce.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp several times to ensure all sand is completely removed.
instructions.2: Slice the onions into rings and layer them in a pot, alternating with the shrimp, celery, mastic, cardamom, and a little salt.
instructions.3: You may add a little water if the shrimp are large.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until cooked through.
instructions.5: Remove the pot from the heat and shake well so the shrimp do not stick together.
instructions.6: Drain and peel the shrimp, then season with salt, pepper, cumin, and lemon juice.
instructions.7: Arrange in a serving dish and top with the mayonnaise sauce (see the Salads section).

instructions.1: Initial preparation: Wash the shrimp several times to completely remove any sand. Slice the onions into rings and layer them alternately with the shrimp, celery, mastic, cardamom, and a pinch of salt in a pot (you may add a little water if the pot is large).
instructions.2: Cover the pot and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until cooked through. Remove from heat and shake well to prevent sticking, then pat the shrimp dry and peel them.
instructions.3: Curry sauce: Sauté the sliced onions in oil until golden, then add the curry powder and stir briefly. Add the water and stir until boiling, then season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
instructions.4: Add the peeled shrimp to the curry sauce just until heated through.
instructions.5: Serving: Ladle into a serving dish alongside white rice, and garnish with lemon and parsley.

instructions.1: Toast the vermicelli or orzo in the ghee.
instructions.2: Pour in the salted broth with pepper and bring to a boil, then lower the heat until cooked (orzo takes longer to cook and may require extra broth).
instructions.3: For extra flavor, you can add mastic to the broth.

instructions.1: Sauté the onion in butter or ghee, then add the flour and stir. Gradually add the broth or water along with the bouillon cube, and let it simmer on low heat until it reaches a boil.
instructions.2: Once cooled, blend the mixture in a blender. Return it to the pot and add the cream, cooked chicken pieces, and milk (adjusting the amount of milk to reach your desired thickness), then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: The chicken pieces can be replaced with shredded cheese.
instructions.4: Ensure the soup is served very hot.

instructions.1: Sauté the sliced onion in butter until golden.
instructions.2: Add the chopped tomato along with the tomato paste and flour, and mix well with the onions.
instructions.3: Pour the broth over the mixture and cook on low heat until done.
instructions.4: Once the mixture has cooled, blend it in a blender.
instructions.5: Whisk a little milk with the egg yolk and salt and pepper, pour it over the blended soup, then return to the pot over low heat for 5 minutes.

instructions.1: Whisk the egg with the salt, pepper, lemon juice, and vinegar thoroughly using a wire whisk.
instructions.2: Carefully add the oil drop by drop until the consistency thickens somewhat.
instructions.3: Place the mayonnaise in a bowl, add the mustard, and mix well.
instructions.4: Transfer to a very dry jar and refrigerate.

salad-04.title: Chicken Salad with Mayonnaise and Toast

instructions.1: After boiling the chicken, cut it into small strips.
instructions.2: Mix the yogurt with the mayonnaise and olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and mix well.
instructions.3: Toast the cubed toast slices in the oven until they turn golden brown.
instructions.4: Pour the mayonnaise mixture over the sliced chicken and serve in a serving dish with the toasted croutons.

instructions.1: Add the garlic to the yogurt along with the salt, pepper, and mint, and whisk well.
instructions.2: Place the salad in a bowl and add small pieces of chopped cucumber, or substitute with a little chopped parsley.

salad-06.title: Garlic and Vinegar Dressing (for Fried Eggplant or Grilled Fish)

instructions.1: Mince the garlic with the cumin and salt, then add the vinegar and mix well.
instructions.2: Serve this salad with fried eggplant and grilled fish.

instructions.1: Chop the green pepper and place it in a blender with the garlic, salt, cumin, vinegar, and lemon juice; then add the boiled chickpeas with the yogurt, followed by the tahini and dried mint.
instructions.2: Blend all ingredients thoroughly, then transfer to a serving dish.
instructions.3: Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Dice the tomatoes and cucumbers, then add the chopped parsley, dried mint, and finely sliced lettuce leaves along with the lemon juice; season the mixture with salt, pepper, and vinegar.
instructions.2: Toast the Shami bread after cutting it into small pieces.
instructions.3: Place the salad in a serving dish, add the black olives, and then top with the toasted bread.

instructions.1: Whisk the mustard with the eggs, either by beating the yolks and whites separately or by beating the whole eggs together.
instructions.2: Add the minced garlic and oil and whisk them well, then add to the egg and mustard mixture and season with salt, whisking thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and reaches a caramel-like consistency.

instructions.1: Mix the boiled vegetables together, then season with half of the mayonnaise sauce.
instructions.2: Pour into a serving dish, cover the surface with the remaining sauce, and garnish with cucumber.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes thoroughly with their skins on.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in salted boiling water until tender, being careful not to let them become mushy.
instructions.3: Peel the potatoes and cut them into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.4: In a deep bowl, prepare the dressing by mixing the oil with salt and cumin, then add the onion juice, minced garlic, and lemon juice or vinegar, and mix well.
instructions.5: Chop the tomatoes and green peppers into medium pieces, finely chop the parsley, then add them to the dressing and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the potato cubes to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.7: Place in the refrigerator until serving time.
instructions.8: General tips for preserving vegetables: Blanch chopped vegetables for freezing by boiling them for one minute in salted water with a little baking soda, then immediately drain in ice water, dry, and pack in airtight bags in the freezer for no more than 3 months (pour directly into hot soup while frozen). To preserve molokhia, after chopping, submerge it in a ladle of broth before freezing. Artichokes are preserved in the refrigerator in boiled water with olive oil and plenty of lemon juice. Potato slices should be boiled for 3-4 minutes, then cooled in water and vinegar before drying and freezing; fry them while still frozen.

instructions.1: Heat about 2 tbsp of oil in a pot over medium heat, add the large grated onion and the meat, and sauté until the meat browns.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar, minced garlic, and either the pureed tomatoes or tomato paste; cook until the tomatoes are softened if using fresh, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Add water, and once it reaches a boil, add the vegetables and spices, then simmer on low heat until everything is tender.

instructions.1: Boil the chicken in boiling water with the onion, cardamom, mastic, salt, and pepper.
instructions.2: Remove the chicken and place it in a strainer, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Blend the large onion, approximately ¼ kg of tomatoes, one small green bell pepper, the garlic cloves, and the tablespoon of vinegar in a blender.
instructions.4: Prepare a cooking pot and add 2 tbsp of oil (or as desired); once the oil is hot, pour in the blended mixture, season with salt and pepper, and let it come to a boil.
instructions.5: Add enough chicken broth to the mixture and bring it back to a boil.
instructions.6: Add the vegetables and simmer on low heat until tender.

vl7-1.name: Vegetables (such as green beans or potatoes)

instructions.1: Prepare a cooking pot with water, salt, a whole onion, and vinegar.
instructions.2: Once boiling, add the vegetables and lower the heat until cooked through, then drain them in a colander.
instructions.3: Prepare a deep bowl with oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, mixing them well, then add the vegetables to it.

instructions.1: Cut the green beans in half lengthwise, then chop them into small pieces and wash.
instructions.2: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, and garlic with the salt and pepper in a blender.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a cooking pot until warm, then pour in the blended mixture and bring to a boil over low heat.
instructions.4: Add the green beans to the mixture and sauté until they begin to wilt.
instructions.5: Pour in the broth and bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cover the pot, adding more broth whenever needed until the beans are cooked through.

instructions.1: Blend the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, garlic, salt, and pepper in a blender.
instructions.2: Place the meat in a pot with oil and sear it, then pour the blended onion and tomato mixture over it until the tomatoes are cooked through.
instructions.3: Add enough water to cover the amount of green beans and bring to a boil, adding salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Once boiling, add the green beans and lower the heat until the vegetables and meat are fully cooked.
